function.description: Returns a list of Port Channel between the LAN Automation associated devices.
function.name: api_getPortChannels

device1ManagementIPAddress.description: The management IP address of the device1.

device1Uuid.description: Unique identifier for the network device1

device2ManagementIPAddress.description: The management IP address of the device2.

device2Uuid.description: Unique identifier for the network device2

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

responses.description: Port channel get response body (Maximum number of records to return in each response is 500)..

allowedVlanRanges.description: Allowed VLAN of the port channel, this option is only applicable to TRUNK connectedDeviceType. (VLAN must be between 1 and 4094 (Ex 100,200,300-400) or 'all'. In cases value not set when connectedDeviceType is TRUNK, default value will be 'all').

connectedDeviceType.description: Connected device type of the port channel.

fabricId.description: ID of the fabric the device is assigned to.

interfaceNames.description: Interface names of this port channel.

nativeVlanId.description: Native VLAN of the port channel, this option is only applicable to TRUNK connectedDeviceType. (VLAN must be between 1 and 4094. In cases value not set when connectedDeviceType is TRUNK, default value will be 1).
